name: Schema Ownership and Namespace Rules
description: Define who owns each schema, namespace conventions, and modification governance rules.
purpose: Every schema has an owner and a namespace — no orphan or ambiguous schemas.
acceptanceCriteria: Schema ownership model documented (individual, team, or auto-assigned)
Namespace conventions defined with examples for each domain
Modification governance rules defined (who can propose, approve, and merge schema changes)
Ownership registry queryable via API or file
Orphan schema detection and alerting mechanism in place
Migration path for unowned schemas to acquire owners
